description: Change your own toolbox: op add adds a tool, op rm removes one, op ls lists the tools you have now (one JSON line). It changes only you (other agents and your definition stay as they are) and takes effect from your next turn. A tool is a folder (with _entry and _tooldef.json inside); give path relative to the workspace, or as an absolute path under the tool library lib/. If the name clashes with a tool you already have, add override: true to replace it.

op.description: add = add a tool, rm = remove one, ls = list them

name.description: the tool name (add, rm); the name you will call it by afterwards

path.description: add: the tool folder, relative to the workspace or an absolute path under lib/

override.description: add: true replaces a tool you already have with the same name (default false)
